claims.explanation: Hydroxyfasudil inhibits ROCK, which in endothelial/tumor cells can activate PI3K/Akt and increase eNOS expression and NO release; PTEN loss and eNOS expression are therefore expected to sensitize cells to NO-mediated killing. Conversely, NFE2L2/KEAP1 mutations that activate the antioxidant response protect against this oxidative stress. Additional mutations in polarity/cytoskeletal regulators such as STK11, NF2, SMARCA4, and SF3B1 may further modulate dependence on ROCK signaling.
